content:
liz: heads up - ACME (regulated pilot) asked if we can build a formalized exception path for pilots that need private/VPC + compliance onboarding. they want price/term flexibility for 6 months. any playbook?

sasha: pinging sales - they want a clear option we can offer quickly. ACME is asking for monthly reserved capacity (no annual commit) + a 50% token discount for the pilot period.

omar: key constraints: dedicated capacity for regs means we tie GPUs up. need clarity on capacity gating + priority vs existing dedicated customers.

noah: product thoughts - we should avoid ad-hoc exceptions. propose: a short-lived SKU "Regulated Pilot" with: 6mo max, explicit capacity envelope, built-in access controls, and a standardized addendum.

julia: legal: agree on standardized addendum. quick sketch: termination-without-penalty in first 90 days, data isolation clause, export control attestation. i'll draft.

mike: finance: any discount widens payback. rough math: 50% token discount on a $120k ARR-equivalent pilot -> ~-$60k over 6mo. need to model churn risk and commit to minimal monthly fee to cover infra.

beth: finance ops: can we require a non-refundable onboarding fee (e.g., $5k) to offset one-off setup? that helps.

ryan: eng: to guarantee isolation we need a capacity slice. what's expected qps / peak tokens?

sasha: ACME estimates 100 qps peak, ~3B tokens/month. they said monthly commitment but won't do >6mo guaranteed.

omar: ops implication: if we carve a pool for them we need a reclaim policy + automated scale-down after pilot ends. otherwise ops burden spikes.

noah: launch/acceptance criteria (suggested):
- security review complete (OKTA, KMS config)
- legal addendum signed
- committed min monthly fee (covering baseline infra)
- capacity slice assigned + autoscale policy + reclaim windows
- runbook for escalation + SLOs communicated

liz: +1 on those criteria. can we put numbers next to them so sales has something concrete to offer?

beth: proposed concrete bundle:
\nsku: REG-PILOT-6M\nsetup_fee: $5,000 (one-time)\nmonthly_retainer: $6,000 (covers reserved baseline)\nper_token_discount: 50% off hosted rate\ncapacity_envelope: 200 qps peak / 4 GPUs reserved\ntermination_window: pilot terminable with 30d notice after month 1\n\njulia: legal will try to shorten termination language to 30 days after month 1, but we need carveouts for infra teardown. also add a confidentiality section.

mike: ask: sales discount cap? we should say discount only applies up to 3B tokens/month; overages billed at standard rate.

omar: tech constraint: 4 GPUs reserved seems ok as short pilot. but autoscale should be capped and billing must reflect bursts.

noah: product decision: proceed with a templated pilot SKU + addendum. responsibilities:
- product (noah): define SKU & acceptance criteria
- legal (julia): draft addendum by EOD + contract-bot to create ticket
- finance (beth/mike): model impact & set min monthly fee
- eng/ops (ryan): reserve pool and create reclaim automation
- sales (sasha): offer to ACME with above terms, get LOI

contract-bot: legal draft created: https://contracts.internal/drafts/REG-PILOT-6M (auto-ticket #PR-719) :white_check_mark:

liz: thanks. let's aim to have an offer ready by COB Friday. sasha, can you confirm LOI timeline?

sasha: i'll push for LOI by Thursday. :thumbsup:

ryan: noted - will start pool provisioning template tomorrow. tagging @eng-oncall for any infra risk checks.

mike: i'll share a simplified P&L by tomorrow morning.

julia: draft will include a shortlist of exceptions we can allow without exec sign-off.

liz: perfect. follow-ups: 1) sasha: LOI timeline 2) julia: draft addendum 3) beth/mike: model 4) ryan: pool + reclaim automation 5) noah: publish acceptance criteria into product playbook. will sync Friday 10am if needed.

sasha: acknowledged.

noah: adding to roadmap backlog under "pricing playbooks" with tag reg-pilot.

liz: end thread - thanks everyone.
